standingsPage.meta.title: {season} standings
standingsPage.meta.description: Drivers' and constructors' standings for {season}: points, wins, podiums, results by race and points progression.
standingsPage.meta.afterDescription: Drivers' and constructors' standings for {season} after {round}, with changes from the previous round.
standingsPage.frozen: This season is over. The standings are final and frozen.
standingsPage.provisional.open: The result of {round} is still provisional – protests can be lodged until {date}. The standings may change until then.
standingsPage.provisional.closed: The result of {round} is still provisional. The stewards are reviewing the last cases; after that it becomes final.
standingsPage.csv.hint: Download the drivers' standings as a CSV file (semicolon-separated, Excel-ready)
standingsPage.seasons.label: Choose season
standingsPage.tabs.label: Standings view
standingsPage.drivers.title: Drivers' standings
standingsPage.drivers.caption: Drivers' standings, {season}
standingsPage.drivers.reserveNote: Reserve drivers (R) score their own points and appear in the drivers' standings with them. Shared positions after a tie are marked with “=” (e.g. =7).
standingsPage.teams.title: Constructors' standings
standingsPage.teams.caption: Constructors' standings, {season}
standingsPage.reserve.label: Reserve points for constructors
standingsPage.reserve.counts: This season, points scored by reserve drivers also go to the team they stood in for.
standingsPage.reserve.notCounted: This season, only regular drivers' points count towards the constructors' standings. Reserve drivers score for the drivers' standings only.
standingsPage.matrix.title: Results by race
standingsPage.matrix.hint: Large number: main race position, below it S: sprint position. Switch to “Points” to see the points for the whole round, including bonuses.
standingsPage.chart.driversTitle: Points progression of the top 10 drivers, {season}
standingsPage.chart.dashed: Dashed line: second driver or second car of the same team. The values are also listed in the table below the chart.
standingsPage.rounds.title: Standings after round
standingsPage.rounds.hint: How did the standings look after a particular race? Pick a round – including changes from the previous round.
standingsPage.rounds.label: Choose round
standingsPage.rounds.none: Once the first round has been scored, you can view interim standings here.
standingsPage.info.title: Points & rules
standingsPage.scheme.title: Points system
standingsPage.scheme.caption: Points per position
standingsPage.scheme.rest: All other positions score no points. Retirements (DNF, DNS, DSQ) score no points either.
standingsPage.scheme.sprintNote: Sprint points are only awarded on sprint weekends.
standingsPage.scheme.fastestLapTop: +{points} in the main race if the driver finishes in the top {max}
standingsPage.scheme.fastestLapAlways: +{points} in the main race for any classified driver, regardless of position
standingsPage.tie.title: Ties
standingsPage.tie.intro: If drivers are level on points, countback decides:
standingsPage.tie.step2: then more second places, then more third places, and so on,
standingsPage.tie.step3: then sprint placings on the same principle.
standingsPage.tie.shared: If everything is still level, the drivers share the position – marked with “=” in the table. The same procedure applies to the constructors' standings.
standingsPage.tie.rulesLinkPlain: Read the rule in the rulebook
standingsPage.champion.title: {season} champions
standingsPage.after.title: Standings after {round}
standingsPage.after.lead: This is how the standings looked after the race on {date}. The arrows show the change from {prev}.
standingsPage.after.leadFirst: This is how the standings looked after the season's first scored race on {date}.
standingsPage.after.latest: These are the latest standings of the season.
standingsPage.after.latestFinal: These are the final standings of the season.
standingsPage.empty.noSeasonText: As soon as the first season starts, you'll find the drivers' and constructors' standings here.
